parameters: \SE[2]Before she knew it, her hand was around her sister's
\SE[2]But from behind her, Reynard's sword pierced Isolde's
\SE[2]As she collapsed, Isolde still looked up at Reynard
\SE[2]"Hey... Did you... ever love me... at all?"
\SE[2]Reynard answered. There was no love. He had only
wanted to play with her―that was all.
\SE[2]At that moment, something inside Isolde shattered.
\SE[2]With the last of her strength, Isolde reached for
Reynard's neck and drove her blade into his throat.
